definitions.explanation: Of poor quality or low standing, below the second rank; said of people, organizations, products and works.

examples.japanese: {三流|さんりゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{役者|やくしゃ}→役者：05113_yakusha⟧。
⟦あれ→あれ：00916_are⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三流|さんりゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧だ。

{三流|さんりゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦{出身|しゅっしん}→出身：03221_shusshin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦{次第|しだい}→次第：03175_shidai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}できる→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧。
examples.english: Even if you graduated from a third-rate university, you can succeed through effort.

notes:
Part of the series ⟦{一流|いちりゅう}→一流：03009_ichiryuu⟧ (first-rate), ⟦{二流|にりゅう}→二流：15294_niryuu⟧ (second-rate), {三流|さんりゅう} (third-rate). {三流|さんりゅう} is plainly dismissive, so it is said of others, or of oneself in modesty or self-mockery.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {三流|さんりゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: third-rate ~
- {三流|さんりゅう}⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧: a trashy magazine
- {三流|さんりゅう}⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧: a low-ranked university
